arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: AMG's counsel argued the law only allows injunctions. He said this prevents keeping stolen money.
The FTC's counsel argued the law allows monetary recovery. He said this serves the statute's purpose.
Justice Alito asked about the relationship to criminal forfeiture. He inquired if the amounts matched.
Justice Alito asked if money was already distributed. He sought to understand the practical impact.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Federal Trade Commission sued AMG Capital Management. The agency wants to recover money from a fraud scheme. AMG argues the law only allows stopping future fraud. The lower court sided with the FTC. AMG now asks the Supreme Court to review that result.
